latest_user_scope.entry: ordinary public playtest homepage; not audio-threaded
latest_user_scope.reported: Picture and controls remain smooth; only audio stutters; initially lighter, gradually worse; background audio improves. Menu lighter but not perfect.
latest_user_scope.consequence: This is not a physical-phone threaded failure. No repeated phone/threaded/GPU acceptance is inferred.

review_scope: Read-only source/lifecycle audit. No production/tool changes, no Godot/browser execution, no long-duration or heap/GC measurement. Only this new evidence JSON written.

entry_boundaries.note: Standard HTML does not load audio_probe.js, shared-observer.js, stream_timing_observer.js or graph probe. Runtime selected assembly/context tracking still operates.
Query enables ambience snapshots at most4Hz and selectedSFX snapshot at1Hz. It does not itself inject the browser audio/graph observer.

Explicit diagnostic counter worklet + mixedPCM meter + RAF/LongTask observer. Graph probe/recording observer in automated evidence may additionally be injected by the runner; not part of ordinary entry.

lifecycle_findings.finding: Exactly12 player nodes allocated once. ensure_buses adds only missing names; subsequent calls do not add buses. Sample/legacy/director consumers reuse inherited pool. director_events capped256; motion_events capped128. Weak playback references are filtered eachprocess and cannot themselves keep playback alive. Stops null streams and metadata; shutdown waits weak release.
lifecycle_findings.limits: Weak-reference list has no numerical cap if backend playback objects remain alive; counts alone need release measurement. Scalar started/played/drop counters increasing is not node accumulation.

lifecycle_findings.finding: Two persistent STREAM players, five-track finite mapping; same requested track returns early. Crossfade stops and nulls inactive stream. Weak playback references pruned eachprocess; shutdown/exit stop players. No new player is created perframe or perloop.
lifecycle_findings.limits: Constant perframe volume updates/crossfade bookkeeping are real work, but static inspection does not establish progressive cost or phone bottleneck.

lifecycle_findings.finding: One lazy reusable GameAmbience component,2STREAM beds+2details. Configuration replaces bank rather than appending. Same context key plus matchingcandidate returns early. One reusable HomeLife child. Owner/death signal callbacks disconnected before rebinding; clear stops/nulls voices. Pause setter has value-change guard.
lifecycle_findings.falsifier: Stable Home context/owner with repeatedly increasing configurations/bed starts or component/player counts would contradict intended steady state and identify a repeatedclear/restart path. Current static source does not prove that happening.

lifecycle_findings.finding: At most4 unique keeper anchors; configure clears prior source/events arrays.64event ring. Sparse12–22s peranchor and6s globalgap; eachdue is consumed even if rejected, so there is no backlog. Blocks/mutes drop detailtails; stop disconnects callbacks and disables processing.
lifecycle_findings.limits: Scalar misses and total starts increase naturally. Last64events and4weak anchors may remain retained while stopped, with finite size.

lifecycle_findings.finding: Validated V3/14mapping configured once; validation_ok makes repeated attach idempotent. Only probe query creates one1s Timer; snapshot takes recent16events, replacing global JS snapshot rather than appending globals.

official_engine_lifecycle.Sample: GodotAudio.samples Map caches registered AudioBuffers. Sample.clear sets buffer null and deletes map entry. getAudioBuffer makes a fresh AudioBuffer copy perSampleNode/restart; allocation churn exists but does not establish retention/leak. Long BGM/beds are STREAM in this production pack, so they do not take Sample-copy loop path.
official_engine_lifecycle.SampleNode: start_sample stops sameplaybackID first. Natural ended(disabled loop) calls stop→clear: remove ownended listener, stop startedsource, disconnect source, clear all per-sample busnodes, null source, return positionworklet to pool, delete sampleNodes entry and report finished. Failed/canceled asyncposition setup checks isCanceled. Ended loop restarts source; clear/reuse are explicit.
official_engine_lifecycle.SampleNodeBus: Per-active-sample channel splitter,6GainNodes,merger. clear disconnects/nulls its nodes; the SampleNode bus Map is cleared. No new bus is created merely by playback time passing.
official_engine_lifecycle.position_worklet_pool: audioPositionWorkletNodes is an intentionally retained reusable pool, growing toward peak concurrent Sample demand rather than total completedplays. It has no hardnumeric cap in officialJS; actual peak/reuse must be observed, not declared a leak from constructor totals.
official_engine_lifecycle.Bus: Bus.setCount only grows on requestedcount; production ensure_buses is idempotent after5buses. Bus.connect disconnects oldsend before reconnecting. Official Bus.clear only removes bus from array and does not explicitlydisconnect its3GainNodes; possible concern for repeated dynamicbus deletion/recreation, but that path is not called by stable formal Home lifecycle. Do not attribute ongoingidle stutter to it without actual buscount/graph evidence.
official_engine_lifecycle.counter_caution: created_total-ended_total is not a reliable live/leakedsource count: sources canceled before start need not emit ended. Monotonic totalplays and pooledworklet highwater are also not leak evidence.

diagnostic_observer_review.bounded: audio_probe rings: starts/created/ended/stops256 each, errors32; contexts32, destinations16, streams16; statechanges64, destination/stream histories128. Source IDs/seen sets use WeakMap/WeakSet. Snapshot rows contain scalar summaries, no retained AudioBuffer payload. sharedobserver16 descriptor records. timing rows256/pending64/RAF1024/LongTask128/contexts16. graph probe weaknode refs1024/edges4096/events256/routes bounded.

uncapped_structure.details: connections Set strongly retains directdestination sources and destination records; edges added atconnect and removed only after explicitdisconnect. No numericalcap or natural-ended pruning. A diagnostic client that creates many unique directdestination branches withoutdisconnect could accumulate observeredges.
uncapped_structure.actual_formal_scope: Official SampleNode sources connect through SampleNodeBus→fixedBus chain; normal directdestination branches are fixedMasteroutput+STREAMworklet. Therefore this structural observer risk is not proof of observedgrowth here and cannot explain ordinary homepage with noobserver. connected_original_branches is an available check.

diagnostic_observer_review.bounded_but_growing_cost: With audio_probe=1, ambience snapshot serializes every250ms and includes HomeLife last64events plus duplicate ambience snapshots. Payload can grow until64events then plateau; SelectedSFX last16events similarlyplateaus. Repeated snapshot arraycopies/JSON and perstart up-to65536sample scans have real diagnostic CPU/allocation cost. They are absent on ordinary no-probe entry.
diagnostic_observer_review.timing_observer_cost: RAF envelope collection fixedring. Snapshot joins each retained timingrow against bounded RAF/LongTask arrays; can become more expensive as rowhistories fill in no-thread timingdiagnostic. Threaded official engine has no chunkcallback hooks, so timingrows are0 and onlyRAF/LongTask observed. Do not compare differently instrumentedruns as proof of phone rootcause.

narrow_observations_for_existing_root_ca: First bind exactentry/build/query and visibility state. User now confirms ordinary page and smoothpicture/controls; do not reclassify as threadedphone failure or GPU failure.

At fixedHome owner/context, compare ambience configurations and bedstarts, activecandidate/player slots, detailstarts versus actualaccepted events. Stableconfiguration/slots with worsening audio weakens an audio-node accumulation hypothesis.

When probes are used, compare contexts/destinations/connected_original_branches, starts and ended with the unstarted-source caveat, exactSTREAMunderrun deltas/audioClock coverage, and RAF/LongTask against visibilitychange. These may test scheduling/supply latency without asserting heap leakage.
Use low-frequency snapshots and mark retainedhistory coverage. Do not add a perframe heap/graph scan or retain unbounded rawsnapshots in the measurement itself.

Home menu inputblock is not necessarily SceneTreepause. Actual in-run pause pausesambience while GameMusic continues withduck; record tree_paused/input_blocked instead of treating everymenu as identical.

Existing publicthreaded8s observations prove finite BGM/cueoutput and0underruns inside thosewindows only. The next informative usercomparison is existingthreaded link on the samephone; no static audit or Cloud sample signs long-duration/thermal/mobile acceptance.
conclusion: No static evidence establishes progressive audio-player/bus accumulation in the current ordinary formal lifecycle. Diagnostic-only boundedhistories and one uncapped directedge Set are disclosed separately. The actual ordinary-homepage symptom remains unresolved; main-thread versus sharedproducer supply is testable with the existingthreaded comparison, without declaring memoryleak, thermal throttling or a phone rootcause.
